items.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996
items.q: But you know then I played lead and you know did my little Tommy Dorsey act.

ctx.x: If you have a character about you, you either can play something really pretty or you can play something really fast, and some of these things you know you can do better than others. And these guys, they can figure this out. And you are usually going to be playing something that you’re pretty strong at. You know I was a pretty high player and I had a pretty tone, so I was always expected to play the ballads. In fact, he never let me play jazz, and I wanted to be hot, and you know he says, “no, no, no, no, no, no”…
Basie had a way of tailoring arrangements to feature his sound?
